title: Integrate INT8 weight-only profiles (GPTQ/AWQ) and add regression test harness
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Add support for INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) into the platform's quantization profile registry and runtime selection logic. Deliver an automated calibration workflow and nightly regression test harness that validates model accuracy against a controlled prompt set and dataset slices. This work covers: (1) ingestion and canonicalization of GPTQ/AWQ profile metadata, (2) integration hooks in the compilation/kernel selector to pick INT8 weight-only runtime paths, (3) a calibration runner to produce per-layer scales using representative inputs, (4) an automated regression suite to detect quality regressions post-quant and across kernel/runtime changes, and (5) console and API flags to opt into INT8 weight-only models with visibility into calibration artifacts. Goal is to enable safe rollouts of GPTQ/AWQ-backed INT8 models for production inference with measurable accuracy tolerances and automated rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime can load a model with GPTQ-style INT8 weight-only profile and serve inference with identical API to FP16 model
Calibration workflow can be executed end-to-end and produce per-layer scale tables stored as artifacts (S3 path), with checksum validation

Nightly regression job runs for 10 representative models and reports metrics: avg token-kl, generation ngram-bleu, and end-to-end latency change; alerts if token-kl > 0.015 or BLEU drop > 1.5 pts on any model slice
Automated PR gating test added: any runtime/quantization change must run lightweight INT8 regression (subset) and pass thresholds before merge
Console shows a per-model "INT8 profile" card with calibration date, profile id, and a link to calibration artifact; toggling to INT8 requires explicit opt-in and shows expected metric deltas
Rollout policy: if production SLO degradation > 3% or customer_impact high, automatic fallback to FP16 variant within configured window
updates: 2025-02-15: Ticket created by Priya. Initial spec posted to Confluence (see links). Proposed split: integration + calibration + regtests. Estimated 5 points.

2025-02-17: Spike completed by Daniel. Confirmed GPTQ and AWQ profile schemas are small delta from existing INT8 profile format; primary differences: per-group block sizes and asymmetric scale quant params. Decision: extend existing profile JSON with 'weight_only_variant' and 'group_block_size' fields to remain backward compatible.

2025-02-18: Calibration runner prototype produced. Uses 50k tokens from the 'calibration-gpt-like-v1' dataset, streaming batches of 512 tokens, collects per-layer activations and computes per-channel scales. Artifact path: s3://redwood-artifacts/quant-calibration/ENG-4921/

2025-02-20: Integration PR opened: runtime PR #2345 implements profile parsing and runtime selection. Initial test shows +0.8% increase in mean token KL on Llama-2-13B when using GPTQ-INT8 weight-only, latency reduced by 25% at same throughput. PR link included.

2025-02-22: Added nightly regtest job in CI and Grafana dashboard panel for INT8 regression. Set alert thresholds and added lightweight PR gate. Next steps: finalize console UI copy and add additional model slices (instruction-following prompts).
notes: Trade-offs discussed: AWQ tends to preserve perplexity better on dense attention layers but requires grouping heuristics; GPTQ is simpler for current kernel paths. We will support both and prefer AWQ for models where validation shows lower token-KL.

Performance risk: INT8 weight-only path currently falls back to slower kernel for fused rotary on some older GPUs. Added runtime instrumentation to detect and record fallback counts; will add capacity routing to avoid heavy fallback on Dedicated fleets.
Calibration UX: calibration artifacts can be large. We will compress with zstd and store diffs for small updates. Retention policy: 90 days by default with manual pinning for release candidates.
